apps.name: 拾闻
apps.summary: 你的 AI 去收集，你在这里看：按你写的主题整理每日资讯，收藏和反馈都留在本机。
apps.note: 需要能读写本机文件、能联网搜索的 AI 工具

en.name: Gleaner
en.summary: Your AI gathers the news; you read it here. Get daily updates on topics you choose, with bookmarks and feedback kept on your computer.
en.note: Requires an AI tool that can read and write local files and search the web

apps.name: Clack
apps.summary: 中英文打字练习：选文章、逐行实时校验、分语言统计速度。

en.name: Clack
en.summary: Typing practice in Chinese and English: choose a text, check each line as you type, and track your speed by language.

apps.name: Readio
apps.summary: 英语听读：逐句音频、翻译查词，收藏句子和生词。

en.name: Readio
en.summary: Learn English through listening and reading: sentence-by-sentence audio, translation and word lookup, with saved sentences and vocabulary.

apps.name: Radio Bob
apps.summary: 个人 AI 电台：一句话点歌，听 Bob 的中文串词。

en.name: Radio Bob
en.summary: Your personal AI radio: request a song in a sentence and hear Bob introduce it in Chinese.
